heading: Verifying a California license for Florida

items.label: California's verification route
items.text: The California Board of Registered Nursing tells current and former California RNs:
items.quote: If you are currently a California RN or previously held a California RN license and are seeking licensure: In another state, you may submit your request via Nursys®.

items.label: Advanced practice certifications
items.quote: Advanced Practice certifications will not be included with RN license verification requested via Nursys.

items.label: What Florida asks for
items.quote: Verification of every license you hold or have held is required.

items.label: Fingerprints
items.text: The checklist also states that "All applicants are required to be background screened" and tells applicants to use the Florida
items.quote: Board of Nursing ORI number when getting your prints taken- EDOH4420Z
